summary: Phase 4 passes acceptance at 35f4a12c. All 3 Phase 4 tasks are [x] and each task first line carries a commit SHA in the phase range (Task 1 b6824b8a, Task 2 6466dd05, Task 3 569e62cc). The closeout gate items 1 to 9 hold with quoted evidence, the cover gates C1 to C5 pass, the 162-row count command printed the expected labeled line, and both person records carry person, time, rows, verdict, and note. Reviews A, B, and C pass at b6326503, adversarial testing passes at 35f4a12c, and the three routed findings RA-P4-1, RA-P4-4, and RA-P4-5 are fixed in the adversarial commit.
